treatment.title: Everything You Will Want to Know.
treatment.sessionsTitle: How many sessions do I need?
sessions: Results become noticeable after the very first session.
Some hair will naturally release approximately two weeks after treatment.
A full course is typically 7–9 sessions, spaced once per month.
You may shave between sessions — please avoid waxing or epilation.
prepare: Shave the treatment area one day prior, in the direction of hair growth.
Avoid solarium or sun-bathing for 1–3 days before your visit.
Arrive with clean skin — no cosmetics, oils or creams on the area.
If you have used a depilatory cream, please rinse off thoroughly.
after: Avoid cosmetics or deodorant on the treated area for the day.
Avoid solarium and active sun for 3–7 days following treatment.
No scrubs for at least 3 days.
Avoid baths, saunas and hot tubs while skin is sensitive.
Only shave between sessions — do not wax or epilate.
treatment.contraindicationsIntro: For your safety, please share any of the following before booking. Our team will guide you with discretion.
contraindications: Acute or infectious diseases accompanied by fever
Malignant or benign neoplasms in the treatment area
Chronic diseases in the acute phase (e.g. epilepsy)
Scars, wounds, or skin diseases at the treatment site
Thrombophlebitis, phlebitis, lymphadenitis, severe varicose veins, vasculitis
